title: Sliding window sums
prompt: window_sums(nums, w) returns the sum of every run of w consecutive numbers. window_sums([1, 2, 3, 4], 2) should be [3, 5, 7], but the last window is missing.
hints: How many windows of size w fit in a list of length n? Count them for n=4, w=2.
The last window starts at index n - w, and range() excludes its stop value.
explanation: The loop used range(len(nums) - w), which stops one start position early. The last window starts at len(nums) - w, so the stop must be len(nums) - w + 1.
